fields.title: Job search / detail record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of topjobs.lk's own server-rendered HTML fields (the site has no JSON API -- see CRAWLING_METHOD.md). Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Full-detail records (search mode with fetchFullDetails=true, or detail mode) carry the complete set of detail-page fields, including descriptionImageUrl -- topjobs.lk publishes the actual job description as an employer-uploaded image, not text, on every listing observed. Search-mode records with fetchFullDetails=false carry only the compact search-result-row fields (jobRefNo, position, employer, town, dates).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The keyword/functionalArea search or job detail URL that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-detail-html, S1-search-html, or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (e.g. not_found, invalid_input, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

jobRefNo.title: Job reference number
jobRefNo.description: topjobs.lk's own numeric job reference (matches the site's "Job Ref No" label).

position.title: Job title
position.description: The job posting's title, as entered by the employer -- occasionally includes salary or extra context in the same string.

employer.title: Employer name
employer.description: May read as "Company Name Withheld" when the employer chose to stay anonymous -- not a login gate, just the employer's own choice.

town.title: Town (search summary)
town.description: Search-summary record only -- the listing table's Town column.

location.title: Location (full detail)
location.description: Full-detail record only -- town plus country, e.g. "Kottawa, Sri Lanka".

openingDate.title: Opening date (search summary)
openingDate.description: Search-summary record only -- not shown on the detail page itself.

closingDate.title: Closing date
closingDate.description: The vacancy's application deadline, as displayed on site (not normalized -- date format varies between the search-summary and detail views).

jobType.title: Job type badges
jobType.description: Full-detail record only -- 0-3 dynamic badges as shown on the listing, e.g. ["Full Time", "Permanent", "Onsite"] or ["Part Time"].

descriptionImageUrl.title: Description image URL
descriptionImageUrl.description: Full-detail record only -- topjobs.lk renders the actual job description/requirements as an employer-uploaded image rather than text; this is that image's URL. Publicly fetchable, no login required.

companyWebsite.title: Employer website
companyWebsite.description: Full-detail record only -- frequently empty/null when the employer didn't supply one.

companyEmail.title: Employer contact email
companyEmail.description: Full-detail record only -- the "Apply by email" address shown on the public page, when supplied by the employer.

jobSpecCode.title: Job spec code
jobSpecCode.description: Full-detail record only -- topjobs.lk's internal job-spec identifier, matches jobRefNo/jc without the leading zero-padding.

jc.title: Job code
jc.description: topjobs.lk's internal job code, required (with ac/ec) to fetch this job's detail page.

ac.title: Agent code
ac.description: topjobs.lk's internal agent code, required (with jc/ec) to fetch this job's detail page.

ec.title: Employer code
ec.description: topjobs.lk's internal employer code, required (with jc/ac) to fetch this job's detail page.

detailUrl.title: Job detail URL
detailUrl.description: Canonical topjobs.lk detail-page URL for this job -- feed this back into "detail" mode's jobUrl/jobUrls input to re-fetch it directly.

jsonLd.title: JSON-LD JobPosting (raw)
jsonLd.description: Full-detail record only, and only present on roughly half of pages observed (topjobs.lk quirk, not this actor's fault) -- the site's own schema.org JobPosting block, passed through verbatim.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across search-summary and full-detail records.
